verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU,ssanyu lyange
Ddundiro ly'omwoyo
Ka nkusinze ggwe!
Ennaku z'omwoyo
Ze zimpaliriza
Ndi wuwo naawe wange,
Nkwagala-okusinga bonna
Ggwe Mukama wange!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Olw'okukuuma kwo
Abalabe bange
Banafu gyendi;
Ssetaani bw'annumba,
Nsaba-ompe amaanyi,
Tombeera wala!
Neetoolooleddwa-obubi
N'okufa kwa ntiisa, naye
Yesu ggwe onkuuma.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ka tugonze-emyoyo,
Ka tumuwe-ekifo
Omusanyusa.
Yesu k'atufuge,
Tumuwulirenga,
Tujjule-essanyu
Mu buyinike bwonna:
Atuwenga-essanyu lino,
Okubeera naffe.
